senses.gloss: to break forth, come to light. Denom. בְּאֵר; cmp. טוּף.

units: Deut. I, 5), to explain; to make clear (to one’s self), to understand clearly.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 3:7:5">Y. M. Kat. III, 83ᵇ</cite> top <he>לבָאֵר משנתו</he> to explain (argue on) what he has learned.
Koh. R. to VI, 9 better is he שהוא מְבָאֵר משנתו וכ׳ who dwells on his studies to make them clear to himself, than he who learns to recite fluently.—Part. pass. מְבֹאָר proven, clear.
<cite ref="Mishnah Yadayim 3:1">Yad. III, 1</cite> <he>מ׳ הדבר</he> (Talm. ed. <he>מ׳ את הד׳</he>) from this fact it is proven.
